author: Mark Atwood
text:
Two-direction workspace decision:
(a) Move JMAP_PRINCIPALS_URI / JMAP_PRINCIPALS_OWNER_URI declarations from jmap-sharing-types to jmap-sharing-server (server-crate canonical, mail-server-style). Touches jmap-sharing-types public API (breaking removal or downgrading to re-export).
(b) Move canonical mail's JMAP_MAIL_URI etc. into jmap-mail-types and propagate the types-crate-canonical pattern across all 7 siblings. Touches 7 type crates + 7 server crates.

Cannot resolve unilaterally in sharing-server: option (a) requires jmap-sharing-types coordination, option (b) requires a sibling sweep. Per /do-beads JMAP-3t94 scope (sharing-server only), filing for workspace direction.
